channel.description: Guides on comparing air fryers and kitchen thermometers. As an Amazon Associate I earn from qualifying purchases.

item.title: Basket or oven-style air fryer: what should you compare?
item.description: The listings we track include two basket-style air fryers and one French-door oven. Here is what to compare, and what this guide does not claim.

item.title: A no-hype checklist for comparing air fryer capacity
item.description: Capacity numbers look simple until you compare them. Units, basket counts, and size variants can all change the answer.

item.title: How to assess cleanup and counter-space trade-offs
item.description: Cleanup and footprint are the two things a product photo rarely answers. Here is how to check them from the listing itself.

item.title: Questions to ask before buying a multi-function kitchen appliance
item.description: Multi-function appliances list many features. Work out which ones you would actually use before you pay for them.
